import json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
files=['y/prices/dex/uniswap/v2.py','tests/test_pool_memory.py','tests/test_pricing_correctness.py','tests/test_routing_scaling.py','tools/validation/pool_discovery_profile.py','tools/validation/compare.py','tools/validation/test_runner.py']
tests=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-P','-m','unittest','discover','-s','/work/tools/validation','-p','test_runner.py'],env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH='/work/tools/validation'),text=True,capture_output=True)
Path('/reports/runner-tests.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code':tests.returncode,'output':tests.stdout+tests.stderr},indent=2))
assert tests.returncode==0,tests.stdout+tests.stderr
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','--no-deps','--target','/tmp/black25','black==25.9.0'],check=True)
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH='/tmp/black25')
version=subprocess.check_output([sys.executable,'-P','-c','from black import __version__; print(__version__)'],env=env,text=True).strip()
assert version=='25.9.0',version
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-P','-m','black','--check',*files],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True)
Path('/reports/format.json').write_text(json.dumps({'version':version,'files':files,'exit_code':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout+result.stderr},indent=2))
assert result.returncode==0,result.stdout+result.stderr
